thresholds.rationale: Validation is the fail-closed boundary for actuarial data quality and must remain above the package-wide coverage floor.
ONNX export is a deployment scoring path where untested branches can produce silent prediction drift.
PMML export is a deployment scoring path and must keep unsupported structures fail-closed.
Diagnostics are actuarial evidence surfaces and need above-baseline branch exercising.
Multinomial helper and prediction code carries high risk because probability rows can look valid while class semantics drift.
Smooth helper functions are compact enough to require complete statement coverage.
Family modules define the mathematical distribution contracts for every GLM fit.
Link modules define the transformations that connect fitted means to linear predictors.
Solver modules are numerically complex and must retain high aggregate line coverage.
Spline modules build smooth design and penalty structures, where coverage gaps often hide boundary bugs.
Rust diagnostics feed actuarial review evidence and should not rely on package-level coverage alone.
